safe_design_checklist.2_reach: PASS: tile <= 432 um side, every intra-tile hop < 405 um; leaf buses leave W (chain 0) / E (chain 1)
safe_design_checklist.3_fanout: FIXED (structural): bounded constructor (tools/qwen_dv/bound_math_netlist.py --load-cap 16, retained operator boundaries) replicates every FF / comb root incl. the shared fill selects b_d/f_q (2585), fep (1707), fill-go line (877), g_pin (759) and reset; the foff rotate selects need >= 34 same-edge copies, so the a_d input lands in one extra pin stage (IN_PIPE, +1 edge) and the replica tree grows from it. ASAP7 mapped census: see results/arch/qw_slice7_1020/xhead/native/census.json
safe_design_checklist.4_depth: PASS: inherited ot_qfd_xhead stage depth (predecessor 481.8 ps / 11 lv); AO21/OA21 fusion; mapped estimate in census ps

safe_design_checklist.8_schedule: static. +1 edge on the head-row input a_d (go, descriptor, fill data, ib together: x column op latency +1, NOTICE to QW-SLICE7 / QW-GRT4 / GEN3); 0 edges from the retag move; reset release +2 as the predecessor
